title: Owner idea: combine merge queues further and further, pairwise on dry trees, while a run is in CI
ruling: Owner 21:45 CST Nov 13, in runner 10's chat, relayed by the consultant (triage did not see it): an idea, not a ruling on a rule. Send subagents to take two large batched PRs and run dry runs, then repeat: 4 subagents with 2 big batch PRs each means 8 combine to 4, then combine further, combining the merge queues further and further while a run is already in CI. Filed as step combine-tournament. It widens no grant: runner 10 already holds a Sonnet Workflow opt-in, and merges stay serial.
